findings.details: Switchroot FFmpeg opens /dev/nvhost-nvdec and /dev/nvhost-msenc through libv4l2, dynamically loads libnvbuf_utils.so.1.0.0 and uses NvBuffer APIs. The existing ACK Tegra DRM/host1x UAPI is a different contract; the codec cannot be promoted as a drop-in mainline implementation.

Mesa26.2.4 nvk_is_conformant explicitly rejects non-discrete Tegra device type; physical-device creation returns incompatible-driver unless a developer override is set. General Maxwell support does not establish working GM20B Vulkan. No override was enabled.
Nouveau OpenGL and Tegra display/render-device buffer sharing remain the primary desktop path. Installing Mesa and passing Hyprland config verification do not qualify real EGL/scanout.
Cached L4T CUDA/vendor libraries are a separate vendor-driver stack and were inspected as ELF files only. No CUDA, OpenCL or Vulkan compute execution is qualified.
Donor scripts include moving-branch pulls, reset and package installation operations. Only source snapshots were harvested; none of the donor build or package scripts was executed.

gaps: NVK Tegra support and conformance work before Vulkan qualification
Modern DRM/host1x media userspace implementation or an explicitly matched isolated vendor stack
Media sample correctness, browser/GStreamer playback and encode/VIC testing
Source Mesa detached signature has been retained but not cryptographically verified
Downstream selected snapshots are interface references, not a complete ready-to-build L4T distribution
